record.paper_title: Open problems, questions and challenges in finite-dimensional integrable systems
record.original_question: Determine obstructions to the global existence of action-a ngle coordinates on regular Poisson manifolds. Realisation problem is also important:

evidence.quote: Problem 6.5. Determine obstructions to the global existence of action-a ngle coordinates on regular Poisson manifolds. Realisation problem is also important:

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,\pi)$ be a regular Poisson manifold, i.e. a smooth manifold $M$ equipped with a Poisson bivector $\pi \in \Gamma(\wedge^2 TM)$ whose induced symplectic foliation has leaves of locally constant dimension. A (non-commutative) integrable system on $(M,\pi)$ is, roughly, a map $F=(f_1,\dots,f_n):M\to\mathbb{R}^n$ whose components Poisson-commute appropriately and whose joint level sets, when compact and connected, are diffeomorphic to tori. Around each such torus, the Liouville–Mineur–Arnold theorem on Poisson manifolds gives local action-angle coordinates.

Problem: Identify and describe the obstructions (cohomological, topological, geometric, or otherwise) to the existence of globally defined action-angle coordinates for such integrable systems on a regular Poisson manifold $(M,\pi)$. In particular, determine a complete set of invariants whose vanishing is necessary and sufficient for the local action-angle coordinates to be patched into global ones, and address the associated realisation problem of which abstract data (action bundles, lattice bundles, transverse structures) can arise from genuine integrable systems on regular Poisson manifolds.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem has been actively studied with partial results. Laurent-Gengoux, Miranda, and Vanhaecke proved an action-angle theorem on Poisson manifolds with local coordinates. Global obstructions for non-commutative integrable systems on Poisson manifolds (using action bundles, lattice bundles, and three transverse foliations) have been investigated, generalizing Duistermaat and Dazord–Delzant. Concrete examples illustrating additional obstructions beyond the symplectic case have been constructed. However, a complete classification of obstructions and a full solution to the realisation problem in the regular Poisson setting do not appear to be definitively established.

status_evidence.title: Global Action-Angle Variables for Non-Commutative Integrable Systems
status_evidence.snippet: Analyzes obstructions to global action-angle variables for regular non-commutative integrable systems on Poisson manifolds; introduces action bundle, action lattice bundle, and three foliations.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a partial framework for global obstructions on Poisson manifolds, extending Duistermaat and Dazord–Delzant.

status_evidence.title: Action-angle Coordinates for Integrable Systems on Poisson Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes a local action-angle theorem on Poisson manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Local action-angle coordinates on Poisson manifolds are established; global version remains nontrivial.

status_evidence.title: Examples for obstructions to action-angle coordinates
status_evidence.snippet: Concrete examples exhibiting obstructions to action-angle coordinates.
status_evidence.claim: Explicit examples show new obstructions arise on Poisson manifolds beyond the symplectic case.
